title: PerfContract
description: The M5 plan-based result contract: an exercise's structural expectations about the plan a learner's query produces. Every assertion is a structural fact read from PlanBundle.summary — there is deliberately no timing field, because a timing is not reproducible on a shared machine.

engine.description: The dialect this contract is written for. A plan captured on another dialect is a refusal, not a mismatch.

require_nodes.description: Node types the plan must contain.

forbid_nodes.description: Node types that must not appear on a relation once the planner expects it to be large. A sequential scan over a twelve-row dimension table is the correct plan and stays legal, which is why the threshold is part of the rule.

max_plan_rows.description: A ceiling on the planner's own top-level row estimate, which is how the contract says 'touch less data' without naming a duration.
